capabilities: Visualize the vault as an interactive 3D graph positioned by embedding similarity
Search notes by meaning and fly the camera to the best match
Show suggested links, potential duplicates, orphan notes, and generate per-cluster MOCs
Replay vault growth over time by note creation date
Export the current graph as an interactive HTML file with deep links back into the vault
extras: Desktop-only and requires Obsidian 1.11.0 or newer; without an API key it falls back to a folder-based clustered sphere layout; pairwise insights are capped at 3,000 embedded notes; UI is English and Korean; HTML export needs internet to load the renderer CDN.
problem: Obsidian's graph view arranges notes by links and folders, so notes about similar topics that are not linked do not appear related.

relations.evidence: OpenAI — fully supported for note and query embeddings.

summary: 3D graph view that positions notes by semantic similarity using OpenAI embeddings or uploaded vectors, with clusters, search, and insights.
